author: calsev
quote:
Clearly, the story is intended to be a focused, humanizing experience about two flawed, ordinary people who forge a bond through shared struggle.

Unfortunately, the storytelling ignores the lessons of literature, cinema, and previous games, trying to force identification and sympathy through tedious participation in the characters' daily lives rather than meaningful character development.

But a tight focus on a relationship is a double-edged sword: prolonged exposure doesn't automatically make characters sympathetic or a story compelling. This may be an ambitious, even excellent game, but the price of admission is embracing an unlikeable, difficult-to-forgive stereotype and a country-voiced dullard.
